definitions.gloss: to come back to life, to be resurrected
definitions.explanation: To return from death or a death-like state. Used literally for revival or resurrection.

definitions.gloss: to be revived, to come back, to be restored
definitions.explanation: To return to an active or flourishing state after a period of decline. Often used for memories, traditions, or past glory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}った。
examples.english: The patient came back to life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{甦|よみがえ}った。
⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}る⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a legend that the ancient king will be resurrected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}った。
⟦{廃墟|はいきょ}→廃墟：12453_haikyo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}りつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The town that had become ruins is being revived.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}る。
examples.english: When I hear that song, memories of my school days come flooding back.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}る.
Transitive form: {甦|よみがえ}らせる (causative, to revive something).

ASPECT (ている):
{甦|よみがえ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the resulting state of having come back to life or been revived.

ETYMOLOGY:
From {黄泉|よみ} (the underworld) + ⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ (to return) — literally "to return from the underworld."

WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{蘇|よみがえ}る→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧. Both {甦|よみがえ}る and ⟦{蘇|よみがえ}る→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧ are used; the hiragana form よみがえる is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}る: memories come back
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}る: memories are revived
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{甦|よみがえ}る: a tradition is revived
